headline: THE ISLAND LANE HELD ON A FULL RE-READ THIS MORNING — every Dauphin Island and Gulf Shores house on this board came back ACTIVE at the price it was already carrying, with one exception worth knowing: 1217 Dorado Way in Gulf Shores now reads $555,000 on the listing page, up from the $539,900 we carried since Friday. Nothing went under contract and nothing disappeared. The Nashville and Knoxville lanes are still frozen at their Jul 29 snapshot because both commercial sites keep refusing our crawler — that unfreezes automatically after Aug 10.
